title: Light Blue Account Referral Program
summary: Light Blue Account Referral Program pays referrers $30 for each successful referral (max 5 per calendar year) when the referred friend opens and funds a Light Blue Account. Friends receive a $20 welcome bonus when they open and fund; they must deposit at least $500 within 60 days of opening.
